column1: # The versions the compatibility sweep runs against, and that docs/compatibility.md reports as
# **Verified**. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for that list.
#   - .github/workflows/compat.yml builds its job matrix by reading this file.
#   - CompatibilityMatrixGuardTest (ntfy-core) asserts docs/compatibility.md's Verified rows list
#     exactly these versions, in both directions.
# So a version can never be claimed in the docs without being swept, or swept without being
# documented. To add or drop a version, edit here and update the matching doc row; the guard test
# The JDK column is explicit on every row rather than defaulted, because the right JDK is a property
# of the version under test, not of the sweep: Micronaut 5 ships Java 25 bytecode in its annotation
# processor and cannot be built on 21, while every 4.x row is deliberately run on 21 to prove the
# project's own baseline still holds. A default would hide that distinction behind an omission.
